vb_textbox.text: There are eight different coloured gnomes that you will see, four of them are assigned to red basket and the other four to a yellow basket,this remain the same throughout the game. Sometimes they yellow baskets are worth more than the red basket or vice versa, when one basket starts decreasing in worth then you should start choosing the other basket(other color)and see if you can earn more.Get yourself familiarize with the baskets and their different colors to do well in picking mushrooms, the higher the mushroom you get the higher your bonus will be. All the best
